text:
maria (partnerships): Quick sync: LangChain asked to run a joint roadshow demo with SigmaCompute featuring our gateway routing + their latest A100 nodes. Need checklist and owners.
aj (eng): We should mirror Dedicated perf for the demo: batching, KV cache, and quant profile. Who can provision?
kevin (devex): I can spin up a demo cluster in sandbox-eu. Tell me model ref, quant flag, and sample prompts.
tom (product): Demo aims: 1) show gateway -> redwood runtime -> sigma GPU path, 2) LangChain chains calling our tooling, 3) visible autoscale/fallback. Keep it short (3min).
jen (marketing): Co-marketing asks: demo video (60s), joint blog, press embargo. Can we aim for demo week Apr 24? Legal needs the quote 72h before embargo.
maria (partnerships): @aj please create scoped demo keys for Sigma and LangChain by Apr 10. No prod access.
aj (eng): Will provision short-lived service accounts + API keys (24h TTL) and post audit links. Also will stub a fallback route to a CPU-quantized variant.
sigma-bot: SigmaCompute access granted to accounts: sally.sigma, lee.sigma (audit: https://internal.redwood/access/sigma) :white_check_mark:
kevin (devex): Example config I need:
```yaml
model: redwood/gpt-compact-v1
quant: int8
batching: burst-16
cache: prefix
```
kevin (devex): Also request 2 long prompts and 3 short prompts so I can warm caches.
jen (marketing): I'll draft the co-branded asset list: logo tiles, one-pager, 60s script, social copy. Legal review scheduled Apr 18.
tom (product): Demo script first draft: 1) user triggers chain in LangChain UI -> 2) gateway route shown in tracing -> 3) redwood runtime calls Sigma GPU -> 4) response & metrics appear in console; inject load to show failover. Link: https://docs.redwood/demo/gateway-sigma
maria (partnerships): Risk list: embargo leak, perf variance, SSO delays, marketplace SKU mismatch. Assign owners?
aj (eng): I take SSO/keys + fallback.
kevin (devex): I take infra + smoke times. Proposed runs: Apr 14 internal, Apr 20 partner rehearse, Apr 23 final.
jen (marketing): I take embargo and assets. Target embargo Apr 24, blog Apr 25.
maria (partnerships): I'll coordinate with Sigma PM for the quickstart image and marketplace blurb. Ask them for container + start docs.
aj (eng): Rollback command for demo: `redwood deploy --cluster demo rollback --model redwood/gpt-compact-v1:stable`
kevin (devex): I'll record boot-to-ready time (goal < 90s) and capture stdout.
sigma-bot: Marketplace preflight: billing SKU and pricing tags due Apr 12. Reminder sent to partners.
maria (partnerships): Thanks all. Posting action items: Aj -> keys, Kevin -> cluster & prompts, Tom -> final script, Jen -> assets & embargo, Maria -> partner comms. Ping here with blockers :rocket:
